content.comment_body: Hello, I've searched through this section but haven't found a solution to my issue. I use [product_name] [version_no] on my Windows 10 laptop with a [product_name] device [article_no]. I connect my laptop directly using a USB/Ethernet adapter and have set the correct IP address for communication. The problem is that sometimes I can't connect to the [product_name] through the Ethernet connection menu—it's often unavailable (greyed out). Notably, I can still ping the device and upload a new program without issue. Does anyone know why the Ethernet connection menu behaves unreliably?

It's hard to know for sure. Is your [product_name] device directly connected to your computer or through a router? What are the IP address and subnet mask for your PC and for the [product_name] device?

Thanks. Yes, the [product_name] device is directly connected to my PC. My PC address is 192.168.0.2, and the [product_name] device address is 192.168.0.4. Both use subnet mask 255.255.255.0. The device responds to pings, but the Ethernet connection menu remains greyed out.
What IP address is assigned to your USB adapter?
I'm not sure I understood. I manually set the IP address for my Ethernet adapter as 192.168.0.2 in the Windows network configuration.

In my setup, I have three network adapters: two physical and one virtual. The one on the right is my USB adapter, and I've configured the protocol (TCP/IPv4) settings accordingly. In [product_name], you need to select the correct network adapter in the interface window for it to work. That's what I was referring to.

Hello, here's my setup. I wasn't able to insert images in the message like you did. I noticed something odd: if I launch [product_name] without opening any file, the Ethernet connection menu is available even with the Ethernet cable unplugged! But when I open a Network project, the Ethernet connection menu turns grey, sometimes becoming available after a delay. I don't understand why this happens.
It could be that your [product_name] installation is corrupted or a Windows update affected it. You may want to contact [company_name] support to get direct assistance.
Thanks, I've just reached out for support. I'll update here when I have news.

I noticed a Bluetooth connection in the background of your screenshot. Some people have experienced similar issues because of it. Try disabling Bluetooth, restart your computer, and see if that helps.

Hello, thanks for your suggestion. [company_name] support was able to reproduce the issue: the Ethernet connection menu becomes grey whenever a network project is opened. The workaround is to close all files and restart [product_name]. It’s not a major problem since uploading projects is still possible when the menu is greyed out. Thanks to everyone for your help.
Interesting, I can't reproduce this problem. When does this happen—consistently, or only when running multiple instances of [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: The user notices that the Ethernet connection menu in [product_name] [version_no] intermittently becomes unavailable, especially when opening a network project. Network communication itself is stable—pinging and programming still work, but the menu for Ethernet connection occasionally appears greyed out, leading to confusion. Direct wired connections via USB/Ethernet adapters do not resolve the unpredictability, and general network troubleshooting has not addressed the menu's behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects stable and consistent access to the Ethernet connection menu within the software whenever network connectivity is established. They also expect clear guidance or error indications when the menu option becomes unavailable.
